definitions.explanation: A piece of ground used for growing plants.
The area of ground around a house.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{花|はな}を{植|う}える。
examples.english: To plant flowers in the garden.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{木|き}が{大|おお}きくなった。
examples.english: The tree in the garden has gotten big.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{庭|にわ}の{花|はな}に{水|みず}をやるのが{日課|にっか}になっている。
examples.english: Watering the flowers in the garden every morning has become my daily routine.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{庭|にわ}で{野菜|やさい}を{育|そだ}てるのが{好|す}きで、{毎日|まいにち}{手入|てい}れをしている。
examples.english: My grandfather likes growing vegetables in the garden and tends to it every day.

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}の{日本庭園|にほんていえん}は{百|ひゃく}{年|ねん}{以上|いじょう}の{歴史|れきし}があり、{四季|しき}おりおりの{美|うつく}しさで{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This inn's Japanese garden has over a hundred years of history and is known for its beauty in every season.

examples.japanese: {広|ひろ}い{庭|にわ}のある{家|いえ}に{住|す}みたい。
examples.english: I want to live in a house with a big yard.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{庭|にわ}で{走|はし}り{回|まわ}って{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are running around playing in the yard.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}がいい{日|ひ}は{庭|にわ}にテーブルを{出|だ}して、{外|そと}で{食事|しょくじ}をすることがある。
examples.english: On nice days, we sometimes set up a table in the yard and eat outside.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した{家|いえ}には{広|ひろ}い{庭|にわ}があったので、{犬|いぬ}を{飼|か}い{始|はじ}めて{毎日|まいにち}{一緒|いっしょ}に{庭|にわ}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The house we moved into had a big yard, so we got a dog and play in the yard together every day.

notes:
{庭|にわ} refers to both cultivated gardens and general yard/outdoor space around a house.

SCOPE:
Unlike English, {庭|にわ} covers both "garden" (planted area) and "yard" (general outdoor space). Context determines which meaning applies.

JAPANESE GARDENS:
- {日本庭園|にほんていえん}: Japanese-style garden
- {枯山水|かれさんすい}: dry landscape garden (rocks and gravel)
- {茶庭|ちゃにわ}: tea ceremony garden

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {庭師|にわし}: gardener
- {中庭|なかにわ}: courtyard, inner garden
- {庭先|にわさき}: front of the garden/yard
- {裏庭|うらにわ}: backyard

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {庭|にわ}の{手入|てい}れをする: to maintain the garden
- {庭|にわ}に{花|はな}を{植|う}える: to plant flowers in the garden
